test_example.details: the student wrote in a journal that they have thought about hurting themselves over grades.
test_example.note:
Date: 2026-10-05

Student: Oscar Zhang, Grade 6, Student ID S376723
Parent/Guardian: Emma Fischer

During our session today, Oscar shared his concerns about his academic performance, specifically his falling grades and missing assignments. In an effort to cope, he mentioned that he has been writing in a journal about his feelings, which have included thoughts of harming himself. This revelation was both surprising and concerning.

I have decided to involve Oscar's homeroom teacher, Mr. Lee, in this matter to ensure a comprehensive understanding of Oscar's current state and to collaborate on appropriate interventions. I will follow up with both Oscar and Mr. Lee within the next 3 days to discuss potential strategies to support Oscar's academic success while addressing his emotional well-being.

I will also reach out to Emma, Oscar's mother, to discuss the situation and ensure that she is aware of the steps being taken to support Oscar. It is crucial that we work together to create a safe and supportive environment for Oscar as he navigates these challenging times.

I will keep detailed records of our conversations and any interventions implemented to monitor Oscar's progress and adjust our approach as necessary. My primary goal is to ensure Oscar's safety and well-being, and I am committed to working diligently towards that end.
